changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.27
- New: clears heatmap on the main window. The CLEARS card now shows a month calendar colored by your daily raid + dungeon clears - hover any day for its counts, and use the arrows to browse the last 3 months.
- New: 30k Slow module. Delays inbound 30k instance traffic with an optional resync bypass. Assign it a key under Keybinds to use it.
